task_definition.task_description: Please scan the smart devices in the living room, then check Alice’s availability for 2025-02-15, and after that turn on the living room light to 70% brightness. Then lock the main lock with PIN 2026, create a medium-priority reminder for 2025-02-15 18:30 titled “Room setup reminder” with a note that the lights were adjusted and the room was locked before the session, and finally make a backup of the `/workspace/iot-room-config` workspace named `pre_session_backup`.

user_input.query: Please scan 1 smart device in the living_room, then check the availability for item_id u_alice on 2025-02-15. After that, turn the device_id light_living on to 70% brightness in the living room. Then set lock_id lock_main to lock using PIN 2026. Also create a medium-priority reminder for 2025-02-15 18:30 titled “Room setup reminder” with the note “Lights adjusted and room locked before the session.” Finally, make a backup of the workspace at /workspace/iot-room-config named pre_session_backup.
user_input.reminder_description: Lights adjusted and room locked before the session.
